So thread an `instanceReceiver` boolean from the call sites that resolve an INSTANCE to a class (the 6d/R4 constructed-local, module-constructed and imported-instance paths, E1 constructed receivers, alias receivers) and apply the guard only there. Class-level calls and super() stay resolving.
